details:
I've been working on my avatar for years and I've never had this problem. 

All PC players can see my PC avatar with all of the PC only objects on it; however, whenever I try to toggle objects on my avatar, the only things non-local players can see toggling on and off are the things I have togglable on the Android side of my avatar. 

I am using isLocal on some parts of my avatar, but not every part.

For me(Local), I can see every toggle perfectly fine.

Android users can see Android toggles perfectly fine. 

But, non-local PC players don't seem to have the same Playable Layers as the Windows upload.

I have something broken on the Android version of my avatar, but since this problem started it's now also broken for non-local PC players.

I feel like VRChat uploading has broken recently, I'm not sure if this happens for everyone, but this problem just started happening in the past week or two.

Also, this problems only happens in VRChat, it does not happen with Gesture Manager or in playmode.
title: Non-local PC players can only see Android Playable Layers (aka FX / toggles)
